newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 dips, no rebound seen before year end.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 dips, no rebound seen before year end.

text.p: Czech shares continued in familiar fashion on Monday with the PX50 index falling 0.1 percent to 515.5 and trade turnover staying below 500 million crowns.
The main index fell despite small gains to all the major issues and dealers said they expected no substantial changes before the end of the year.
"At the moment we're not seeing much activity and I do not expect it to pick up before Christmas," said Radim Bajgar of ING Barings.
The four most highly capitalised shares all rose, pushing the major issue dominated RPIX index up 2.7 points to 1,064.43.

Investment funds again dominated the continuously traded session. SPIF Cesky accounted for 34 million of the total 41 million crowns turnover. SPIF rose 10 crowns to 440 while RIF was up five crowns to 820.
In the broader market, the biggest decliner was regional energy distributor Stredoceska Energeticka which lost 108 crowns to 2,059.
Paper maker Sepap also fell sharply, dropping 50 crowns to 962.
